ITI.NS.d: ITI Limited engages in the manufacture, sale, and servicing of telecommunication equipment primarily in India. Its telecom products and solutions include switching, transmission, access, and subscriber premises equipment.

KANOHAR.NS.d: Kanohar Electricals Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker KANOHAR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

LAXMIDENTL.NS.d: Laxmi Dental Ltd. makes and supplies dental products to India, the United States, the United Kingdom and other markets. MAHABANK.NS.d: Bank of Maharashtra provides various banking products and services in India. The company operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking segments. It accepts savings, current, and term deposits, as well as capital gain account schemes.

Its product portfolio also encompasses acid dyes, direct dyes, pigment powders and emulsions, synthetic food colors, specialty chemicals, inorganic chemicals, and excipients.

MEDANTA.NS.d: Global Health Limited operates in India under the Medanta brand as a multi-specialty tertiary care provider. MSTCLTD.NS.d: MSTC Limited engages in marketing, e-commerce, other, and scrap recovery and allied job businesses in India. SJVN.NS.d: SJVN Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation and sale of power in India, Nepal, and Bhutan. TEMBO.NS.d: Tembo Global Industries Limited manufactures and fabricates various steel products in India and internationally. TRIDHYA.NS.d: Tridhya Tech Ltd. is a full-service software development company that provides a range of IT services and resources. TTKPRESTIG.NS.d: TTK Prestige Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets kitchen and home appliances in India and internationally. VGCL.NS.d: Vibrant Global Capital Limited is an Indian financial services company providing investment banking, corporate advisory, and wealth management services.
